SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro.en: Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!
SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro.fr: Bienvenue au 10F !\nC'est si gentil de me rejoindre !

SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle.en: Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.
SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle.fr: Bien joué, mais la salle du conseil\nest au-dessus !

SilphCo_10F_Text_KeepMeCryingASecret.en: About me crying…\nPlease keep it a secret.
SilphCo_10F_Text_KeepMeCryingASecret.fr: Ne raconte à personne que j'ai\npleuré !

SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisPostBattle.en: Are you satisfied with beating me?\nThen go on home!
